files.description: 7-page EHI Export documentation PDF for ezPractice V15.1. Describes the (b)(10) export mechanism: ZIP files containing C-CDA R2.1 XML (clinical data + HTML rendering), CSV (adhoc patient notes with 6-column schema), and CDA XML with Base64-encoded scanned records. Includes file naming conventions, brief format descriptions, fee disclosures, and compliance statement. This is the primary artifact.

CSV listing FHIR server endpoints (test and production). Contains 4 rows: test FHIR endpoint (http://Lab.penn-clinical.com/fhir-server/api/v4/), test auth endpoint, and production endpoints listed as 'available upon request'. This is for the (g)(10) FHIR API, not the (b)(10) EHI export, but was linked from the same ONC navigation menu.
